data.title: 卡提希娅 · 铁匠铺的保养
data.description: 铁匠铺，她把迅刀交给师傅保养，趴在柜台边看锻打的火花；聊起剑的手感时眼睛发亮——比起圣女，她更习惯骑士的身份。
data.action: 铁匠铺，她把迅刀交给师傅保养，趴在柜台边看锻打的火花
data.lighting: 铁匠铺锻炉熊熊烈焰火光与工作台顶灯
data.promptProse: At the smithy, Cartethyia, with a blond braid, luminous halo and cropped blue traveling jacket, leans over the counter to watch her blade. An older smith with a close gray beard and a soot-dark leather apron raises the hammer beyond her at the anvil. Forge light follows the blade through the spray of sparks.
data.animaCaption: Blond Cartethyia in the cropped blue jacket watches from the counter. Beyond it, the gray-bearded smith in a soot-dark leather apron holds the hammer above her blade on the anvil.
